title: [Toyota Times] Beyond Tariffs and the Middle East Situation: Returning to Sustainable Growth
summary: Toyota announced its financial results for FY2026. With impacts from tariffs and the situation in the Middle East, the company forecasts a third consecutive year of profit decline. How will Toyota return to sustainable growth while building earning power #TOYOTATIMES
body_markdown:
Toyota announced its financial results for FY2026. With impacts from tariffs and the situation in the Middle East, the company forecasts a third consecutive year of profit decline. How will Toyota return to sustainable growth while building earning power that can withstand change? Here are the key takeaways.
